description: Land Title Settlement Department - Buthpitiya, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510803
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, extents, and encumbrances in designated locations. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
